content:
“You must be double-jointed!”

**Goat Legs** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Take no damage from falling.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Take no damage from falling. | 003D2955 | 

- Although the same 100% damage reduction from falling can be achieved by using two armor pieces with Acrobat's Legendary mod, or by using power armor, neither remove the Superman landing.
- Before update 60, the perk had 2 ranks that reduced damage from falling by 40%/80%.
